target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go EPaxos package with shared replica transport, master registration, configuration entry and command State. Other protocols named by README/run.go are outside this investigation.
protocol_contexts: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
Default run: static configured peers; F=(configured replicas-1)/2; crash failures described by runReplica; durable=false, thriftiness=true, LRead=false, Dreply=true.
external_interfaces: Replica typed RPC stream over TCP
ownership: Protocol run serializes message handlers. Separate execution goroutine consumes shared InstanceSpace; network listeners decode and enqueue RPCs.
selection_injection: Constructors accept peer list, failures and execution flags; in-repository runReplica supplies defaults.
variants: Optional durability, batching, transconf and beacon adaptation
unknowns: No crash-restart reconstruction or dynamic membership contract established.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Origin-row owners preaccept commands and attributes; replies drive fast commitment or accept/majority commitment. Full Commit propagates decisions. Recovery can resume these paths.
entry_points: B_phase1: Client proposal or recovery restart invokes startPhase1; received PreAccept invokes handlePreAccept.
B_form: PreAcceptReply or AcceptReply arrives for an instance.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Per-instance bal guards incoming work; lastTriedBallot qualifies replies and vbal orders recovered metadata. Prepare acquires higher promises, while recovery resets coordinator bookkeeping. The master leader flag is a ballot-selection hint.
entry_points: B_prepare_wire: replyPrepare -> SendMsg -> Marshal; registered New -> Unmarshal -> handler channel.
B_recover_select: PrepareReply reaches handlePrepareReply while preparing.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Execution discovers missing/uncommitted work and queues per-instance recovery after repeated blocked scans. Recovery solicits prior state and resumes formation.
entry_points: B_recovery_watch: Execution scan repeatedly encounters absent, uncommitted or commandless instance.

activities.realization_summary: Master registration fixes peer IDs/list; configuration supplies F. EPaxos forces thrifty sending and chooses live preferred peers. No dynamic reconfiguration path is established.
entry_points: B_membership: runReplica registers, computes f and constructs EPaxos; peer connection setup marks peers alive.

activities.realization_summary: Committed dependency graph is traversed by Tarjan SCC; eligible commands execute in sorted SCC order, then status becomes EXECUTED.
entry_points: B_apply: executeCommands calls Exec.executeCommand on committed instances with commands.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Optional append/sync helpers record selected state; default entry disables durability. A restart reader and durable-mode initialization remain unknown.
entry_points: B_history: recordInstanceMetadata, recordCommands and sync at selected handler sites.
unknowns: Crash-restart applicability is unknown; default crash-stop operation uses no durable store.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: PROPOSE supplies command and reply identity; batch bookkeeping retains correspondence until execution response. Retry semantics are explicitly unfinished in handlePropose.
entry_points: B_client: Decoded PROPOSE enters delayed proposal channel, then handlePropose.

behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
behaviors.trigger: Client proposal or recovery restart invokes startPhase1; received PreAccept invokes handlePreAccept.
implementation_guards: PreAccept below inst.bal is dropped. Existing ACCEPTED or later instances retain metadata; missing commands are handled separately.
reads: Per-row key conflict indexes, maxSeqPerKey, local instance status and ballot.
writes: Initiator installs PREACCEPTED with bal=vbal=ballot; creates bookkeeping whose seq is -1 and ballot is -1, with lastTriedBallot set to the attempt ballot.
Receiver below ACCEPTED computes attributes, sets PREACCEPTED/PREACCEPTED_EQ, bal/vbal and commands; records key conflicts.
external_effects: Initiator broadcasts to preferred live peers, FastQuorumSize()-1 when thrifty.
Receiver returns current bal, vbal, status, seq, deps and committed prefix.
async_boundaries: run serializes handler calls; network receipt and execution happen in separate goroutines.
unknowns: Command fill uses LeaderId rather than Replica in the ACCEPTED-or-later branch; recovery may make them different.

behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
behaviors.trigger: PreAcceptReply or AcceptReply arrives for an instance.
implementation_guards: PreAcceptReply checks lastTriedBallot and bookkeeping phase. AcceptReply checks ACCEPTED and exact lastTriedBallot.
writes: PreAccept replies increment support and merge attributes; a larger VBallot replaces bookkeeping value metadata.
Fast threshold plus allEqual, allCommitted and initial ballot commits; otherwise threshold enters ACCEPTED and broadcasts Accept.
Accept replies at the attempted ballot commit when acceptOKs+1>N/2.
external_effects: Commit sends full commands and dependencies to live peers; early client replies only if Dreply is false.
important_branches: N<=3 and Thrifty bypass equality accumulation. Committed-dependency checks run only for N>7.
On higher PreAcceptReply ballot, nacks may cause IsLeader to makeBallot and bcastPrepare. In AcceptReply the inequality return precedes the higher-ballot branch.
unknowns: Threshold applicability and implicit self support need separate scrutiny; values are mapped as code observations, not qualified quorum proof.

behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
implementation_guards: Below-promise ballots and COMMITTED/EXECUTED instances do not replace seq/deps.
writes: Eligible branch assigns Deps, Seq, bal and vbal; does not assign Status or commands.
external_effects: AcceptReply contains current bal, including on rejection.
unknowns: Does retaining prior status after positive acceptance allow recovery to misclassify support?

behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
implementation_guards: Ignore if already COMMITTED/EXECUTED or incoming ballot below inst.bal.
writes: Install command, seq/deps, bal/vbal and COMMITTED; update conflict indexes and contiguous committed prefix.
external_effects: No reply is sent by this entry; application is through executeCommands.
important_branches: Own-row NOOP commitment requeues retained proposals and clears their original association.

behaviors.execution_owner: Protocol run goroutine; BeTheLeader RPC sets leader hint
behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
implementation_guards: Recovery returns if already committed with commands. Prepare only raises bal; replies even for stale requests.
writes: Recovery replaces bookkeeping while retaining client proposals and copying old value fields; makeBallot chooses Id or Id+N and raises toward maxRecvBallot only when IsLeader.
Recovery sets its local bal and vbal to lastTriedBallot and inserts a self PrepareReply. Prepare reception raises bal without changing vbal.
external_effects: Recovery broadcasts Prepare to all other live peers. handlePrepare constructs a reply using current identity, promise, vbal, status, command and attributes and sends it to the requesting leader.

cross_activity_effects.A1: A new attempt later consumes returned value tags and status to select the next formation path.

unknowns: Repeated attempts can reuse ballots; strict increase and old-reply handling beyond equal-ballot filtering remain unresolved.

behaviors.protocol_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
implementation_guards: Preparing flag and exact reply Ballot equality; collects SlowQuorumSize replies including self.

facts.meaning: The local instance holds command/attribute metadata, status and value tag vbal separately from promise bal; this describes stored state, not a certified quorum or invariant that every tag/status pair is valid.
facts.validity_context: Replica.InstanceSpace[origin replica][instance], with local promise bal, value tag vbal and per-attempt LeaderBookkeeping.
representation: Instance.Cmds, Seq, Deps, Status, bal, vbal
facts.durability: Volatile in the default run; optional record routines do not establish reconstruction.
facts.recovery: Copied into bookkeeping and PrepareReply; recovery can replace metadata.
unknowns: Validity of retagging and status transitions remains open.

facts.meaning: At reply construction in handlePrepare, the report identifies the local acceptor and requested instance and copies the current promise ballot, stored value ballot, status, commands and attributes. This is a producer report, not a guarantee of preservation at the receiver.
facts.validity_context: Constructed by handlePrepare after applying any higher promise, before replyPrepare serialization. Commands/dependencies reference local slices until marshalled.
facts.durability: Transient RPC object; not durable history.
facts.recovery: Coordinator filters Ballot and selects metadata using VBallot and Status.
unknowns: Preservation of nonzero VBallot across the production codec has not been executed.

facts.meaning: The local instance is marked COMMITTED by reply aggregation or installation of a received Commit, with commands and ordering metadata. The marker alone does not prove a valid quorum or completed execution.
facts.validity_context: Local Instance.Status >= COMMITTED; application further requires commands and committed dependencies.
facts.durability: Volatile by default; per-path optional records described in B_history.
facts.recovery: startRecovery skips committed instances with commands; prepare selection has a committed case.
unknowns: Global agreement and dependency ordering remain to be checked.

surfaces.reason: VBallot is declared and populated by the producer and consumed in recovery selection, but omitted by both codec directions. Principal investigation.
Eligible accept updates value fields but not Status; prepare selection distinguishes ACCEPTED from PREACCEPTED/NONE. Preserve as independent lead.
Repeated attempts can select the same ballot; local recovery also rewrites vbal before its self report. Legal delayed-reply consequences remain uninvestigated.
bal and vbal overwrite the same bytes. Default mode disables persistence; applicable restart contract not established.
TryPreAccept branch repeats prior condition and appears unreachable; separate receive/response code exists but current production entry history is unresolved.
Key-indexed attribute construction and range-aware SCAN conflict semantics differ; scan caller eligibility and actual ordering consequence need investigation.
Server TODO is observed; complete client-side retry, reconnection and timeout contract remains unread.
Local proposeTime resolves equal seq and same-row ties. Whether a legal SCC contains such ties remains open.

formation.explanation: Client proposals allocate an origin-row instance and preaccept with dependency/sequence attributes from conflict indexes. Acceptor preaccept reports are filtered by the coordinator attempt and phase; replies merge attributes. The configured fast threshold with equality/commit-prefix/initial-ballot conditions commits; otherwise an Accept phase uses acceptOKs+1>N/2. Commit broadcasts full commands and dependencies; receivers install only when not already committed and not below their promise. Execution waits for dependency availability/commitment, traverses SCCs, executes and responds through retained client proposals. Actual formulas and absent status changes are observations requiring validation, not assertions of quorum sufficiency.

context.explanation: Authority is scoped to origin-row/instance and ballot, not one global log leader. startRecovery replaces bookkeeping, retains proposals, chooses an attempt ballot, retags its local entry and includes a self report before Prepare broadcast. Remote Prepare raises only the promise bal and reports vbal separately. Coordinator accepts matching-attempt replies while preparing, waits for SlowQuorumSize including self, selects by VBallot, then installs committed data, resumes Accept, or restarts phase1. Old requests below a local promise are dropped/reported without replacement; old reply ballots and finished phases are filtered. Same-ballot reuse and preservation of value tags through codecs are open local anomalies.

connection.explanation: Recovery reports are the bridge from prior formation to authority transfer: promise Ballot qualifies the new attempt, while VBallot and Status decide which existing support the new coordinator uses. Commit/execute states constrain overwrite and skip ordinary recovery. Pending proposals survive bookkeeping replacement and may be requeued on own-row NOOP commit. The execution watcher can solicit recovery for missing/uncommitted known work; master selection only influences makeBallot through IsLeader. Wire decoding lies directly on the report path and must be investigated before treating reported value tags as preserved. No unread persistent recovery mechanism is assumed to repair it.

open_details: PrepareReply VBallot wire preservation is the first selected discriminator.
Accepted status retention, ballot reuse/retagging and quorum formula applicability remain separate leads.
Durable restart contract, SCAN dependency coverage, equal-sequence SCC ordering and full client retry policy remain unresolved.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation and authority paths, caller/transport boundaries and application/recovery support have been read. Usable navigation does not validate the observed thresholds, state transitions or transport semantics.
